description: Approved fixtures for debt simplification (Min-Cash-Flow greedy matching). Participant indices map to fixed GUIDs in test code.

scenarios.name: CircularThreePerson
scenarios.description: A owes B $50, B owes C $30, C owes A $20. Net: A=-30, B=+20, C=+10

scenarios.name: ComplexFourPerson
scenarios.description: 6 debts among 4 people. Net: A=-30, B=0, C=0, D=+30. Collapses to single transaction.

scenarios.name: SymmetricTwoDebtors
scenarios.description: U1 and U2 both owe U3 $50 each. Already optimal.

scenarios.name: LargeAmounts
scenarios.description: U1 owes U2 $1,234,567.89, U2 owes U3 $987,654.32. Tests decimal precision at scale.
